behaviour: Adds actionChangeArrowheadSize (a RadioSelection of small/medium/large) and renders it inside actionChangeArrowProperties.
rules: 1. Imports: DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE in the "@excalidraw/common" value import; normalizeArrowheadSize next to getArrowheadForPicker from "@excalidraw/element"; ArrowheadSize in the `import type` list from "@excalidraw/element/types". FontSizeSmallIcon, FontSizeMediumIcon and FontSizeLargeIcon are already imported.

2. `export const actionChangeArrowheadSize = register<ArrowheadSize>({ name: "changeArrowheadSize", label: "labels.arrowheadSize", trackEvent: false, perform, PanelComponent })`, placed right after actionChangeArrowhead.
3. perform: `invariant(value, "actionChangeArrowheadSize: value must be defined")`; `const arrowheadSize = normalizeArrowheadSize(value)` (undefined for "medium").

4. perform elements: changeProperty(elements, appState, (el) => ...) returns el unchanged when !isLinearElement(el) or normalizeArrowheadSize(el.arrowheadSize) === arrowheadSize; otherwise newElementWith(el, { arrowheadSize }). No elbow re-route.
5. perform returns appState `{ ...appState, currentItemArrowheadSize: value }` and `captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY` (undoable).

6. PanelComponent ({ elements, appState, updateData, app }) renders
{t("labels.arrowheadSize")}
group="arrowhead-size" .../>
like actionChangeStrokeWidth.

7. Options in order: small (text t("labels.arrowheadSize_small"), icon FontSizeSmallIcon, testId "arrowheadSize-small"), medium (labels.arrowheadSize_medium, FontSizeMediumIcon, "arrowheadSize-medium"), large (labels.arrowheadSize_large, FontSizeLargeIcon, "arrowheadSize-large").

8. value = getFormValue<ArrowheadSize | null>(elements, app, (element) => isLinearElement(element) ? normalizeArrowheadSize(element.arrowheadSize) ?? DEFAULT_ARROWHEAD_SIZE : appState.currentItemArrowheadSize, (element) => isLinearElement(element), (hasSelection) => hasSelection ? null : appState.currentItemArrowheadSize); onChange={(value) => updateData(value)}.
9. actionChangeArrowProperties' PanelComponent renders renderAction("changeArrowheadSize") right after renderAction("changeArrowhead") so the compact and mobile arrow popover show it.

sites.rule: Insert a blank line and actionChangeArrowheadSize per rules 2-8.

style_from.reason: actionChangeStrokeWidth: the discrete-choice register/perform/RadioSelection shape the new action copies.

behaviour: Re-exports actionChangeArrowheadSize with the other property actions.
rules: 1. Add `actionChangeArrowheadSize,` to the export list from "./actionProperties", right after actionChangeArrowProperties.

behaviour: Shows the arrowhead size control right after the arrowhead pickers in the full styles panel.
rules: 1. Under the same predicates.arrowheads condition, render renderAction("changeArrowhead") followed by renderAction("changeArrowheadSize") inside one fragment; no new predicate.
2. Compact and mobile layouts are not edited: they render changeArrowProperties, which now includes the control.

behaviour: Paste styles copies the arrowhead size along with the arrowheads.
rules: 1. Import normalizeArrowheadSize in the existing `import { newElementWith, syncStickyNoteInk } from "@excalidraw/element";`.
2. In the arrow branch compute `const arrowheadSize = normalizeArrowheadSize(elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize);` (the copied JSON is untrusted) before the newElementWith call.

3. The newElementWith update keeps startArrowhead and endArrowhead and adds `...(arrowheadSize !== normalizeArrowheadSize(newElement.arrowheadSize) ? { arrowheadSize } : {})`, so a default-to-default paste adds no key; the elbow re-route after it is unchanged.

behaviour: Arrows drawn with the arrow tool take this.state.currentItemArrowheadSize.
rules: 1. In the newArrowElement call of the linear-element pointer-down handler add `arrowheadSize: this.state.currentItemArrowheadSize,` right after `endArrowhead,`; the newLinearElement (line tool) call is unchanged.

sites.rule: Insert the arrowheadSize option per rule 1, at the same indentation.

behaviour: A sketched line upgraded to an arrow takes app.state.currentItemArrowheadSize.
rules: 1. In maybeUpgradeLineToArrow's newArrowElement call add `arrowheadSize: app.state.currentItemArrowheadSize,` right after endArrowhead.

sites.rule: Insert the arrowheadSize option per rule 1.

behaviour: Converting to a sharp or curved arrow applies app.state.currentItemArrowheadSize, as it applies the current arrowheads.
rules: 1. In the sharpArrow and curvedArrow cases add `arrowheadSize: app.state.currentItemArrowheadSize,` right after endArrowhead (it overrides the size spread from the element).
2. The line and elbowArrow cases are unchanged: elbow keeps the element's own arrowheads and size through the spread, line keeps whatever the spread carries.
